opening.argument: The pitch ties paid OneCoin packages to token allocations, then presents submitting tokens as a way to generate coins in a personal account. It predicts that OneCoin’s value will increase and that participants can expect “a very decent capital gain.” The narration directly links joining to profit from the cryptocurrency and urges viewers to “get started.” These claims make package purchase and participation the path to projected appreciation and income, while invoking technical explanations and the founder’s credentials to reinforce the appeal.

citations.quote: Where you, by submitting your tokens, will be able to generate coins to your own personal account.
With a high demand, the expected value of a single OneCoin will, over the next couple of years, increase and we can expect a very decent capital gain.
By joining the concept you not only profit from the cryptocurrency but also position yourself for the future economy.
Make sure to get your questions answered by the person who showed you this video and get started.
